name: Visapult
definition: Visapult is a distributed, parallel volume rendering application designed for interactive visualization of massive datasets (terabyte-scale) over Wide Area Networks (WAN). It addresses the problem of network-I/O bottlenecks and latency in remote visualization by decoupling rendering from data transfer.
summary: Visapult is a parallel IBRAVR engine that enables interactive visualization of terabyte-scale datasets over WANs by decoupling rendering from image assembly to reduce network data load.
